Custom Guitar Innovations browse by type pitch/octave octaver octave fuzz octave fuzz (1 octave up) browse by enclosure pedal Custom Guitar Innovations Octavio Published on June 12, 2007 Custom Guitar Innovations octave fuzz (1 octave up) pedal Information Custom Guitar Innovations The item your viewing is faithful reproduction of the tycobrahe octavia. These are hand made one at a time. This version is specially converted to operate on negative ground power, and is compatable with a series power supply. The octavio is designed to bring the ultimate octave pinging sound, it incorpates a pair of carefully selected diode to highlight that octave up pinging sound. Frustrated with octavias that are too harse and distorted well we were able to keep it smooth and musical like the orginals. Jimi hendrix used this type of pedal on the solo to purple haze among many other classic tracks.
